source_2.content: Synthetic research fixture, not a real publication: observational study of 60 adults aged 18-65 over 4 weeks. Greater variation in bed and wake times was associated with less favorable cardiometabolic markers. It did not test interventions, establish causation, prescribe treatment, or classify any individual. Sleep consistency is a hypothesis worth tracking alongside sufficient sleep opportunity, not a demonstrated individual treatment effect.
